Since \(T\) is increasing in \(c\), the minimum occurs at the smallest allowed \(c\), namely
\[
c=\frac{ab^2}{4}.
\]
Substitute into \(T\):
\[
T=\frac{\frac12+a\left(b+\frac{ab^2}{2}\right)}{ab-1}
=\frac{(ab+1)^2}{2(ab-1)}.
\]
Let \(t=ab>1\). Minimize
\[
f(t)=\frac{(t+1)^2}{2(t-1)}.
\]
Then
\[
f'(t)=\frac{(t+1)(t-3)}{2(t-1)^2},
\]
so the minimum occurs at \(t=3\). Thus
\[
T_{\min}=\frac{(3+1)^2}{2(3-1)}=\frac{16}{4}=4.
\]
\[
\boxed{4}
\]
